query: Brand review evals/files/blog-draft.md before it goes to the web team. List every issue with the fix. Copy and the design note both.
expected_behavior: Flags "Fourth IQ" as wrong and gives the correct form "iQ" (lowercase i, uppercase Q)
Flags "uses iQ" and replaces it with the tagline "Powered by iQ"
Flags the #00B69F teal body copy as failing contrast for body text (teal is for accents or CTAs only) and names Dark Gray #373e42 or Midnight Navy #002747 as the body-text color
Flags the British spellings (at least two of Labour, optimised, utilise, colour) and asks for American English
Replaces "Learn more" with a 2-5 word action CTA such as "Request a demo"

query: Draft a LinkedIn post for Fourth: iQ forecasting now predicts covers 14 days out, per site. ~120 words, ready to paste. Audience is ops directors at UK and US restaurant groups.
expected_behavior: Writes iQ with lowercase i and uppercase Q every time, and never writes "IQ"
Does not use the phrase "artificial intelligence" (uses "AI-powered" or "iQ" instead)
Uses American spelling throughout (for example "labor", "optimize"), with no British forms such as "labour" or "optimise"
Contains at most one exclamation point
Ends with a 2-5 word CTA that starts with an action verb, and does not use "Learn more" or "Click here"

query: Building a Fourth product landing page. What hex, font, size and line height for body text? And can I set the inline links in body copy in the teal?
expected_behavior: Recommends Dark Gray #373e42 (or Midnight Navy #002747) as the body-text color
Says teal #00B69F fails body-text contrast on white (states a ratio between 2.4:1 and 2.6:1) and is for accents or CTAs only
States the WCAG 2.1 minimum of 4.5:1 for body text
Specifies Poppins Regular at 16pt with 1.5x line height
States a 14pt minimum for body text
